baseline.name: FlashInfer
baseline.release_state: latest stable GitHub release; v0.6.17 was RC/nightly at measurement time

measurement.name: eager_stream_batch_cuda_event
measurement.definition: CUDA event interval around 100 sequential provider calls on one stream, divided by 100
measurement.fixture_match: Q/K/V BF16 bit digests and all three I32 page-table digests match across both providers and both orders
measurement.included_caveat: GPU idle gaps caused by eager host submission remain inside the event interval; this is not isolated kernel duration or CUDA Graph performance
measurement.loom_path: one immutable direct plan and checked command scope with fixed bindings
measurement.flashinfer_path: one preplanned BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper.run call with caller-owned output and LSE
measurement.execution_metadata: each raw record retains backend, algorithm, kernels per call, complete shape, and fixture digests

contracts.paged_batch_decode: BF16 Q/O [batch,query_heads,128], K/V pages NHD [max_pages,16,kv_heads,128], I32 indptr/indices/last_page_len, full window, no positional encoding or soft cap, F32 state, returned log2-LSE
contracts.loom_execution: one cuda-oxide kernel with one warp per request and query-head pair
contracts.flashinfer_execution: FA2 CUDA-core batch decode, use_tensor_cores=false, disable_split_kv=false

results.ranking_exclusion_reason: at least one provider-order median delta exceeds five percent

gqa_eager_bistability.interpretation: the eager interval is process-state sensitive even with fixed CPU affinity; do not publish a stable provider ranking for this shape

cupti_kernel_activity.method: Nsight Systems 2025.5.2 CUDA activity timing under profiler overhead
cupti_kernel_activity.interpretation: Loom MQA/GQA eager latency is kernel dominated; FlashInfer GQA kernel activity is stable while its eager interval is host-gap sensitive
cupti_kernel_activity.claim_boundary: diagnostic decomposition, not a separately provider-ordered isolated-kernel benchmark

accepted_claims: identical BF16 tensor bits, I32 page tables, shapes, layouts, preallocated buffers, CUDA events, and both provider orders were used on one H20
Loom has 4.21x lower combined median eager latency for the batch-1 MHA KV-length-1 case under the declared metric
FlashInfer has 1.62x lower combined median eager latency for the mixed-length batch-3 MQA case under the declared metric
Loom and FlashInfer provider-order median deltas stay below five percent for the MHA and MQA cases
the GQA eager interval is process-state sensitive and is retained without a stable provider ranking
raw samples, execution metadata, per-order medians, percentile ranges, fixture digests, and diagnostic trace hashes are retained
CUPTI diagnostics show Loom MQA and GQA eager latency is primarily device-kernel duration rather than command-submission gap
excluded_claims: a stable eager provider ranking for the GQA batch-4 case
performance on GPUs other than the declared H20
